title: Naming hygiene: drop identity aliases, fix stray whitespace
description: Cleanup of the 26 standing warnings surfaced by the validator naming wave: aliases identical to their row's canonical_name are removed (zero information loss), doubled spaces in notes collapsed. Enables promoting both checks from warn to error.
